The courageous men, who have not been named, both fired shots at the suspect, Chad Williams, after he opened fire at the restaurant on Saturday around 2.30pm in Twin Falls, Police Chief Matthew Hicks said.

item.title: [114] Japanese Yen Carry Trade and Government Intervention
item.description:
Because the Japanese government has long maintained negative interest rates, the cost of borrowing yen is effectively zero.
A large number of financiers borrow yen to make substantial overseas financial investments.
The global financial industry has become heavily reliant on yen-denominated borrowing.
In 2020, the pandemic caused the yen to depreciate sharply, and Japan experienced severe inflation.
The Bank of Japan must raise interest rates; otherwise, the yen will continue to depreciate.
Once the Bank of Japan begins raising interest rates, yen carry trades will come to an end, which is highly likely to trigger a global financial crisis.
Currently, the Bank of Japan is reluctant to raise interest rates and is instead relying on government intervention to buy yen and prop up the market.
This is virtually meaningless, as the yen will continue to depreciate after a brief rebound. All the money used to prop up the market has been pocketed by financiers.
Meanwhile, the U.S. government has effectively blocked any increase in Japanese interest rates.
What exactly should Japan do?
If it doesn’t raise interest rates, it will fall into hyperinflation.
If it raises interest rates, the global financial sector will immediately plunge into crisis,and it will also provoke the United States.

item.title: [386] MORROWIND / TES Thread
item.description:
What is it about Morrowind that makes it so good in spite of its flaws?

I've been put off by Morrowind because I thought it would feel janky and old. And actually, it does. But at the same time it's quickly becoming my favorite over Skyrim and Oblivion, but I can't quite pinpoint why.

There are the obvious flaws, like NPC simulation being relatively poor. For example, it's dumb af that I can sleep in at the Mage's Guild, then be awakened by a Dark Brotherhood assassin who tries to stab me to death whilst everyone in the building stands in place and doesn't react.

But at the same time, I don't think Oblivion or Skyrim comes anywhere close to crafting a worldspace that feels anywhere close to as real, authentic, unapologetic, and LIVED-IN as Morrowind.

So can we agree on Morrowind > Skyrim > Oblivion ?

item.title: [ 40] Justice Dept. admits Reflecting Pool renovation was flawed, drops case against former Olympian
item.description:
https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/31/politics/doj-admits-reflecting-pool-renovation-flawed-drops-case-david-hearn

The Justice Department is admitting that a President Donald Trump-prompted $14 million renovation on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, DC, was flawed, and is dropping the criminal case against former Olympian David Hearn that accused him of damaging the pool, according to a new court filing from DC US Attorney Jeanine Pirro.

“It was not until after the return of the indictment [of Hearn], that the [Department of Interior] provided additional documents to the [US Attorney’s Office in DC] indicating that damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in June 2026 was the result of flawed installation by the contractor, Atlantic Industrial Coatings, and the rush to complete the project prior to events associated with the America 250 celebration in the weeks surrounding Independence Day 2026,” Pirro’s office wrote.

Hearn’s attorneys said in a statement reacting to the decision, “The Trump administration’s case against David Hearn should never have been brought. Its dismissal today does not erase the abuse of government power in arresting and charging a patriotic American who did nothing wrong. The government’s approach was ready, fire, aim. The administration owes Mr. Hearn an apology.”

When CNN called the contracting company Friday evening, an employee with Atlantic Industrial Coatings said they hadn’t heard anything about the new filing, adding, “No comment.”

Americans are largely tolerant of scandals among politicians. But nobody is more willing to stick by an embattled candidate than a MAGA voter.

The POLITICO Poll finds President Donald Trump’s MAGA supporters are the most loyal of any group of voters — with majorities saying they would stick by GOP candidates confronted with an array of scandals, from a DUI conviction or accepting lobbyist gifts to more serious accusations including domestic violence, sexual assault and antisemitic social media posts.

item.title: [195] /sip/ - So I'm A Pokemon
item.description:
Boulder Mon edition
Previous >>59389214

>FAQ
>What is this?
People are turning into Pokemon in the real world. Some are having the time of their lives, and some are struggling to survive. These are their stories.
>How do I join?
Just start posting.
>What's the lore?
People and animals (and at least one tree) are changing at random in their sleep, waking up still in the real world, but now as Pokemon, and nobody knows why (that includes you. Please don't try to explain it). Just enough transformations are occurring to notably change day-to-day life without collapsing civilization. This is not the apocalypse, even if it might feel like it to some characters in the moment. Some people are more in touch with their instincts than others, and some have lost more of their humanity than others. That's about it. Avoid legendaries if possible.
>What the Hell is PIPS?
In many of the stories, the scientific community in-universe has begun referring to Pokemon instincts and the loss of humanity some people who transform experience as Pokémon Induced Psychosis Syndrome, or PIPS. The term is explained in more detail here: https://rentry.org/sip-concepts

item.title: [306] /zzz/ - Pokémon Sleep General
item.description:
Turbo Turbulence Edition

What is Pokémon Sleep?
Pokémon Sleep is a sleep tracking app that utilizes your smartphone and/or the Pokémon Go Plus + device to record data as you sleep. In doing so, you'll be able to meet a variety of Pokémon and fill out your Sleep Style Dex.

Be sure to post your Research ID so that you can add and share candy with fellow Anons. We are currently locked at 50 friends.

FAQ:
>How do Shinies work?
If you encounter a shiny Pokémon, a single Poké Biscuit will auto-befriend it.
>What should I spend my diamonds on?
Expanding your ingredient pockets, item pockets and Pokémon box. Long term you’ll want to max out ingredient pockets, everything else is up to what's convenient for you.
>When should I use my items?
When you have a good grasp of the game mechanics. You may want to save up Recovery Incenses for event missions.
>What should I spend my sleep points on?
Poké Biscuits first or if you’re a premium user: Main and Subskill seeds and Great Biscuits.
>Can I play this game if there's a lot of noise where I sleep?
The game tracks sleep based on motion only; sound has no impact.
>A Pokémon I fed got full! Will I have to start from scratch the next time I find one?
Nope! Pokémon retain any progress from when you last saw them.
>How do dream clusters work?
The higher your research rank, the more shards you get. You may want to hold onto them as long as possible.
